description: Rules the model shipped and no fixture had ever exercised. Written after a diagnostic asked, for every symbol the model names, whether any lowered program produces it -- and answered that 130 of 304 never had. Most are libraries no corpus uses; some were a spelling the frontend never emits, which is a rule that cannot fire and looks exactly like a rule that found nothing. Every finding here was already described in the model. The point of the file is that the description and the frontend agree.

expected.note: subprocess.run, the modern spelling and the one no fixture had
pickle.loads, reached through the METHOD form of the request body -- `request.get_json()` appears 44 times across the clean corpus and was not a source at all
jinja2.Template compiled from a caller's text

the direct form of a weak hash, which the named-algorithm rules never covered. Reported and never gating: across the clean corpus the direct form is 44 of the 80 weak-hash findings, every one examined being a cache key, an ETag or a Gravatar URL
